summary.text: Larry Brown is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a former state representative for Strafford 3 and describes his professional experience as including work as a rehabilitation counselor and social worker.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia says Brown's professional experience includes working as a rehabilitation counselor and social worker.
Ballotpedia lists a term in the New Hampshire House representing Strafford 3 from 2005 to 2010, during which he served on the Municipal and County Governments committee.
Brown was a candidate for the House in later years without winning, including a 2015 special election for Strafford 1 and general elections in 2014, 2016, 2020, 2022 and 2024.
